name: Dovetail
tagline: Dovetail is a customer insights platform that uses AI to organise and synthesise qualitative research — interviews, survey responses, support tickets, and reviews. Its AI Magic features automatically transcribe, tag, and cluster data into themes, reducing hours of manual analysis to minutes.
